name: DigiRezept Dauermedikation Rezeptanfrage
author: meinrezept

sections.description:
Add your practice’s MeinRezept prescription form to WordPress. Configure the practice once in the settings, then place the form with a shortcode or a Gutenberg block. Optionally load the Online Reception script in the header of public pages.

Features

  • Settings page: country, practice slug, form style, background, primary color, edges, alignment, heading, large-view link, privacy notice, iframe height and width
  • Online Reception script in the site header (on by default), with paths that can be excluded
  • Reception uses the saved country and practice slug. Its own style is Standard or square; side and primary color are optional
  • Shortcode [rezeptanfrage] – no attributes; uses your saved settings
  • Gutenberg block “Rezeptanfrage” in the MeinRezept category
  • Embed URL is built for you (no free-form iframe URLs)
  • Admin connection test (checks whether the form URL responds)

External service

This plugin loads the form from MeinRezept. The address depends on the country selected in the settings. When someone opens a page with the shortcode or block, their browser connects to that service. The admin connection test may also request the form URL from your WordPress server.

If Online Reception is enabled, public pages load online-reception.js from the same host, except on paths listed as exclusions. The script is not loaded while the feature is off.

Privacy / legal information: mein-rezept.at/impressum-datenschutz

The plugin does not store patient form data in WordPress.

Notes

Works on normal posts and pages. No page builder required. Some security plugins or themes block iframes; in that case the form may not appear.

Privacy

  • The form is loaded from MeinRezept when the shortcode or block is used. The address depends on the selected country.
  • If Online Reception is enabled, public pages load online-reception.js from that host, except excluded paths. It is not loaded while the feature is off.
  • The connection test may contact the same host from your server.
  • No analytics or ads are added by this plugin.
  • No patient submissions are stored in WordPress.
  • Service privacy details: mein-rezept.at/impressum-datenschutz
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (or upload the digirezept-dauermedikation-rezeptanfrage folder to wp-content/plugins/).
  2. Open Settings → MeinRezept and save the country and practice slug.
  3. Add your WordPress domain under Integration → Allowed domains in the MeinRezept practice dashboard.
  4. Add [rezeptanfrage] or the Rezeptanfrage block to a page or post.
  5. The Online Reception script loads on public pages by default. Under Online-Rezeption, set style, side, or primary color if needed. Leave side and color empty to use the script defaults. List paths such as /kontakt under exclusions to skip those pages, or clear the checkbox to stop loading the script.

Requires WordPress 5.8+ and PHP 7.4+.
sections.faq:
Do I need a page builder?

No. The shortcode and the block work in the standard editor.

Where is the block?

In the block inserter, category MeinRezept, block Rezeptanfrage (or search for “Rezeptanfrage” or “MeinRezept”).

Does the connection test prove my domain is allowed?

No. It only checks that the form URL is reachable. Domain allowlisting is done in the MeinRezept dashboard (Integration → Allowed domains).

Does WordPress store patient data?

No. Only your settings are stored (country, slug, form appearance, iframe size, and the optional reception options).

What does Online Reception do?

Public pages load online-reception.js in the header when the country and practice slug are saved. The checkbox under Settings → MeinRezept is on by default. The script uses the saved country and practice slug. Style (Standard or square), side, and primary color are set in the Online Reception section and do not follow the form style. Side and color can stay empty. Clear the checkbox to stop loading the script.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Online Reception script in the header, on by default. Style, side, and primary color are set separately from the form. Leave side empty to place it on the right. Exclude paths such as /kontakt, one per line.
  • Form appearance: primary color, edges, alignment, and optional heading, large-view link, and privacy notice.

1.0.0

  • First release: settings, shortcode, block, style/background options, connection test
